title: Fitness Plus not showing
body: I am a Portuguese citizen living abroad and Fitness Plus is available in Portugal. So why can’t I use it? Doesn’t even show.
author: Kradirhamik

title: We need more custimization
body: I'd appreciate if the rings could be customized beyond just goals. Many, like myself, prioritize steps, distance, or specific workouts over standing time or calorie counting. Having options like steps goal, floors climbed, or cardio fitness would be valuable for those of us with active routines who do not really need/want to track their calories or standng time.
author: IvSib
